Simply spend $5 or more at Frost Bites, present your receipt at the front counter, and receive one free game of bowling. Even better, EMT Meal Cards are accepted at Frost Bites, making Eat & Play an easy and affordable way to enjoy your lunch break. Offer Details: Thursdays & Fridays

events.description: 🏺 Clay Hand-Building: Custom Tic-Tac-Toe Board Perfect for family game night or a creative weekend project! Take family game night to the next level with a board made entirely by hand! Whether you stick with classic “X” and “O” markers, candy, or use playful miniature shapes like bears, airplanes, leaves, or sea otters, your finished set will be a one-of-a-kind keepsake built to last. sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit the Military Personnel Flight within required timelines. Use the official newcomers page for JBER reporting instructions.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Office before arrival for on-base waitlists and off-base referrals. Temporary lodging is available through the base lodging office where offered.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival and assist with base orientation. Contact your gaining unit if no sponsor is assigned before departure.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource, Military.com, and BaseDirectory for relocation support.
